 FC Imphal City congratulates Ronandev on making it to India U-15 Squad 
 Source: The Sangai Express 
 Imphal, October 21 2026: 
FC Imphal City congratulated its former player Aheibam Ronandev on his selection to the India U-15 team for the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival 2026 to be held in Baku, Azerbaijan.
The club extended best wishes to Ronandev and the Indian contingent led by Head Coach Bibiano Fernandes.
 FC Imphal City congratulates Ronandev on making it to India U-15 Squad 
Ronandev is the second son of Aheibam Barudev Singh and Aheibam Ongbi Premila Devi of Wangbal Mayai Leikai, Thoubal District.
Before joining FC Imphal City, he developed his skills with various clubs and academies in Manipur, said FC Imphal City in a congratulatory note.
After joining FC Imphal City, the club facilitated his trials at top football academies in India, which earned him selection to the AIFF-FIFA Talent Academy in Odisha under FIFA Talent Development Scheme, it said.
Ronandev's journey from grassroots football in Manipur to representing India is an example of structured player development and added that it provides 100% scholarship for talented players from Manipur and Northeast to train at prestigious academies, it added.
